_說明: 福利檢查（/deals/ 嘅「福利檢查」分頁）。每項福利嘅文字（中英）、金額同官方連結喺 items；用嚟判斷資格嘅數字喺 tables（按住戶人數排：第 1 個 = 1 人）。每 3 個月由 Claude 定時任務按 scripts/benefits-quarterly-prompt.md 核對官方來源更新。改完請執行 python scripts/validate_benefits.py。判斷規則喺 assets/js/benefits.js，數字改咗唔使改程式。

haWaiver._說明: income = 部分減免入息上限（1 至 5 人或以上），fullIncome = 一般可獲全數減免嘅入息上限；資產上限 = 公屋資產限額（tables.prh.assets）

summary.zh: 18 歲或以上嘅香港居民修讀指定課程，完成後可以申請發還部分學費。
summary.en: Hong Kong residents aged 18 or above can claim back part of the fees for approved courses after finishing them.

amount.en: Up to $25,000 per person: 80% of fees for the first $10,000 of subsidy, 60% for the remaining $15,000

apply.zh: 報讀「可獲發還款項課程」，出席率達 70% 及評核合格，修畢後一年內向持續進修基金辦事處網上或郵寄申請發還。
apply.en: Enrol in a CEF reimbursable course, meet the 70% attendance and assessment requirements, and claim within one year of finishing, online or by post.

notes.zh: 開課時要年滿 18 歲，2022 年 8 月起開課嘅課程唔設年齡上限；同一課程唔可以同時獲其他公帑資助。
notes.en: You must be 18 when the course starts; no upper age limit for courses from August 2022. The same course can't also receive other public funding.

source.zh: 在職家庭及學生資助事務處：持續進修基金
source.en: WFSFAA: Continuing Education Fund

summary.zh: 15 歲或以上合資格僱員可以報讀。失業人士讀「就業掛鈎課程」學費全免，課程 7 日或以上仲有再培訓津貼。
summary.en: Eligible employees aged 15+ can enrol. Placement-tied courses for unemployed people are free, with a retraining allowance for courses of 7 days or more.

amount.zh: 就業掛鈎課程：免學費，再培訓津貼每日 $333（每月上限 $8,000）；其他課程月入 $15,000 或以下可申請豁免學費，$15,000 以上至 $23,500 只付資助學費
amount.en: Placement-tied courses: free, retraining allowance $333 a day (cap $8,000 a month). Other courses: fee waiver for monthly income $15,000 or below; subsidised fee for over $15,000 up to $23,500

apply.zh: 經僱員再培訓局網站、熱線或委任培訓機構報名。
apply.en: Apply through the ERB website, hotline or an appointed training body.

notes.zh: 就業掛鈎課程為失業嘅香港永久性居民等而設；各課程有自己嘅入學要求。
notes.en: Placement-tied courses are for unemployed permanent residents and some other residents; each course has its own entry requirements.

source.zh: 僱員再培訓局：課程簡介
source.en: ERB: course overview

summary.zh: 15 至 29 歲、學歷副學位或以下嘅青年，可以參加求職培訓、工作實習同有薪在職培訓。
summary.en: Young people aged 15 to 29 with sub-degree education or below can join job-search training, work placements and paid on-the-job training.

amount.zh: 完成工作實習（出席率 80% 或以上）可獲實習津貼 $8,000；在職培訓期間以僱員身份支薪
amount.en: $8,000 placement allowance for completing a work placement (80%+ attendance); paid as an employee during on-the-job training

apply.zh: 經勞工處「展翅青年就業計劃」網站或熱線登記做學員。
apply.en: Register as a trainee on the Labour Department YETP website or hotline.

source.zh: 勞工處：展翅青年就業計劃
source.en: Labour Department: YETP

name.en: Greater Bay Area Youth Employment Scheme

summary.zh: 18 至 29 歲、持副學位或以上學歷嘅青年，可以應徵企業喺大灣區內地城市嘅職位。
summary.en: Young people aged 18 to 29 with sub-degree education or above can apply for jobs with companies in Mainland GBA cities.

amount.zh: 學士或以上學歷月薪不低於 $18,000；副學位按市場薪酬
amount.en: Monthly salary at least $18,000 for degree holders; market pay for sub-degree holders

apply.zh: 喺勞工處「互動就業服務」大灣區青年就業計劃專頁應徵職位。本屆招聘期至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。
apply.en: Apply for jobs on the Labour Department Interactive Employment Service GBA page. The current round runs until 31 December 2026.

source.zh: 勞工處：大灣區青年就業計劃
source.en: Labour Department: GBA Youth Employment Scheme

summary.zh: 欠緊學生資助處貸款，而因為繼續全日制進修、經濟困難或患重病令還款有困難，可以申請延期還款。
summary.en: If you owe a student loan and have trouble repaying because of full-time study, financial hardship or serious illness, you can apply to defer repayments.

amount.zh: 部分計劃喺延期期間唔計利息；還款期最多可延長兩年
amount.en: Some schemes charge no interest during deferment; the repayment period can be extended by up to two years

apply.zh: 喺分期還款到期日之前，用指定表格連證明文件交學生資助處。
apply.en: Submit the form with supporting documents to the Student Finance Office before the instalment due date.

notes.zh: 申請時貸款帳戶唔可以拖欠超過一期季度還款（或連續五期月供）。
notes.en: Your loan account must not be more than one quarterly (or five monthly) instalments in arrears.

source.zh: 學生資助處：延期還款
source.en: Student Finance Office: deferment

name.zh: 專上學生資助（助學金及貸款）

summary.zh: 全日制讀學士、副學士或高級文憑，可以按家庭入息同資產申請助學金同貸款；唔想經審查，亦可以申請免入息審查貸款交學費。
summary.en: Full-time students on degree, associate degree or higher diploma courses can apply for means-tested grants and loans, or a non-means-tested loan for tuition fees.

amount.zh: 助學金幫交學費同學習支出，貸款應付生活費；免入息審查貸款最多可借全年學費（2026/27 學年合併終身上限 $419,400）
amount.en: Grants cover tuition and study costs, loans cover living costs. Non-means-tested loans can cover the full tuition fee (combined lifetime limit $419,400 in 2026/27)

apply.zh: 經學生資助處網上平台申請：公帑資助課程用「資助專上課程學生資助計劃」（TSFS），自資課程用「專上學生資助計劃」（FASP）及「專上學生免入息審查貸款計劃」（NLSPS）。每個學年都要申請。
apply.en: Apply online to the Student Finance Office: TSFS for publicly funded courses, FASP and NLSPS for self-financing courses. Apply every academic year.

notes.zh: 要有香港居留權，或者課程開始前本人或家庭已連續住港滿 3 年。免入息審查貸款由發放日起計利息（讀書期間都計）。
notes.en: You need right of abode, or you or your family must have lived in Hong Kong for 3 continuous years before the course starts. Non-means-tested loans charge interest from the day they are paid, including while you study.

source.zh: 學生資助處：專上程度學生資助（TSFS、FASP、NLSPS）
source.en: Student Finance Office: post-secondary student finance (TSFS, FASP, NLSPS)

summary.zh: 住戶入息同資產低過限額、冇住宅物業，就可以申請公屋。
summary.en: Households under the income and asset limits that own no residential property can apply for public rental housing.

amount.en: Rent far below private market; 2026/27 income limits: 1 person $13,230, 2 people $20,680, 3 people $25,870, 4 people $32,020

apply.zh: 網上或郵寄向房屋署遞交公屋申請表。
apply.en: Submit a PRH application to the Housing Department online or by post.

notes.zh: 非長者一人申請以「配額及計分制」編配，輪候時間較長。強積金法定供款可以喺入息扣除。
notes.en: Non-elderly one-person applicants are allocated under the Quota and Points System, with longer waits. Mandatory MPF contributions can be deducted from income.

source.zh: 房屋委員會：入息及資產限額（2026 年 4 月 1 日起）
source.en: Housing Authority: income and asset limits (from 1 April 2026)

summary.zh: 輪候傳統公屋三年或以上嘅家庭（二人或以上），可以申請先入住簡約公屋，唔影響公屋輪候。
summary.en: Households of two or more who have waited three years or more for PRH can move into Light Public Housing first, without affecting their PRH application.

amount.zh: 租金約為同區新落成公屋嘅九成，例如每月約 $900 至 $3,310（視乎項目同面積）
amount.en: Rent about 90% of nearby new PRH, e.g. about $900 to $3,310 a month depending on project and size

apply.zh: 經房屋局簡約公屋網站申請；而家全部項目都接受申請。
apply.en: Apply on the Housing Bureau Light Public Housing website; all projects are now open for applications.

notes.zh: 公屋申請正處於凍結或暫緩階段嘅，要等完結先可以申請。
notes.en: If your PRH application is frozen or suspended, wait until that ends.

source.zh: 房屋局：簡約公屋
source.en: Housing Bureau: Light Public Housing

summary.zh: 冇住宅物業、入息同資產喺限額之內，可以用白表申請買居屋。
summary.en: If you own no residential property and are within the income and asset limits, you can apply to buy a HOS flat with the White Form.

amount.zh: 樓價以市價折扣出售；白表限額：一人每月入息 $30,000、資產 $615,000；二人或以上 $60,000、$1,230,000
amount.en: Flats sold at a discount to market price. White Form limits: one person $30,000 a month income and $615,000 assets; two or more $60,000 and $1,230,000

apply.zh: 留意房委會推售公布，喺接受申請期內網上申請。居屋 2025 已於 2026 年第二季接受申請。
apply.en: Watch for Housing Authority sale announcements and apply online during the application period. HOS 2025 took applications in Q2 2026.

source.zh: 房屋委員會：居屋資格準則
source.en: Housing Authority: HOS eligibility

name.zh: 白表居屋第二市場計劃（白居二）

summary.zh: 白表人士抽中配額，就可以用未補價價錢，喺二手市場買居屋、綠置居等資助出售單位；40 歲以下可以揀參加「青年計劃」。
summary.en: White Form buyers who win a quota can buy subsidised flats such as HOS and GSH on the secondary market without paying the premium. Applicants under 40 can join the Youth Scheme.

amount.zh: 未補價單位樓價一般低過同區私樓；白居二 2025 配額 7,000 個（包括 2,000 個青年配額）。限額同居屋白表：一人每月入息 $30,000、資產 $615,000；二人或以上 $60,000、$1,230,000
amount.en: Unpaid-premium flats usually cost less than nearby private flats. WSM 2025 had 7,000 quotas (including 2,000 for the Youth Scheme). Limits as for HOS White Form: one person $30,000 a month and $615,000 assets; two or more $60,000 and $1,230,000

apply.zh: 留意房委會公布，喺申請期內申請；白居二 2025 申請期為 2026 年 4 月 30 日至 5 月 20 日（已截止）。獲配額後 6 星期內要申領「購買資格證明書」。
apply.en: Watch for Housing Authority announcements and apply during the application period; WSM 2025 took applications from 30 April to 20 May 2026 (now closed). Successful applicants must get a Certificate of Eligibility to Purchase within 6 weeks.

notes.zh: 「青年計劃（白居二）」：申請截止時年滿 18 歲，而申請開始時未滿 40 歲；成功嘅青年申請者要做業主或聯名業主。
notes.en: Youth Scheme (WSM): you must be 18 by the closing date and under 40 on the opening date, and must be an owner or joint owner of the flat you buy.

source.zh: 房屋委員會：白表居屋第二市場計劃
source.en: Housing Authority: White Form Secondary Market Scheme

name.en: Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership (GSH / HOS)

summary.zh: 住緊公屋嘅住戶可以用綠表，以更低價錢申請買綠置居或居屋。
summary.en: PRH tenants can use the Green Form to apply to buy GSH or HOS flats at lower prices.

amount.zh: 綠置居定價一般低過居屋；居屋單位綠表同白表配額比例為 50:50
amount.en: GSH flats are usually priced below HOS; HOS flats are split 50:50 between Green and White Form buyers

apply.zh: 留意房委會推售公布，喺接受申請期內申請。
apply.en: Watch for Housing Authority sale announcements and apply during the application period.

source.zh: 房屋委員會：居屋資格準則
source.en: Housing Authority: HOS eligibility

name.en: Priority housing for families with newborns or elderly parents

summary.zh: 申請公屋時有初生嬰兒，或者同 60 歲或以上父母一齊申請，可以縮短輪候時間；買居屋或綠置居亦有優先選樓配額。
summary.en: Public housing applicants with a newborn, or who apply together with a parent aged 60+, wait less; there is also a priority quota when buying HOS or GSH flats.

amount.zh: 公屋：「家有初生」輪候時間縮短 1 年；「天倫樂」（同長者一齊申請）提早 6 個月處理；兩者合共最多縮短 1 年。居屋／綠置居：預留約 40% 單位俾「家有初生」同「家有長者」申請者優先選樓
amount.en: Public housing: 1 year less waiting for families with newborns; 6 months earlier for the Harmonious Families Priority Scheme (applying with an elderly person); at most 1 year in total. HOS/GSH: about 40% of flats reserved for families with newborns or elderly members to choose first

apply.zh: 公屋：喺申請表加入嬰兒（要喺嬰兒滿 1 歲或之前加入），或者同長者一齊申請並揀參加「天倫樂」。居屋／綠置居：喺申請表揀參加「家有初生」或「家有長者」優先選樓計劃。
apply.en: Public housing: add the baby to your application on or before the baby's first birthday, or apply with the elderly person under the Harmonious Families Priority Scheme. HOS/GSH: opt into the newborn or elderly priority scheme on the form.

notes.zh: 嬰兒要喺 2023 年 10 月 25 日或之後出生；居屋／綠置居計嬰兒 3 歲或以下，或家庭成員已懷孕滿 16 週。「天倫樂」要同長者同住或入住就近單位並照顧佢。2026 年施政報告：由下一期居屋起，有新生嬰兒嘅白表家庭最高按揭成數提升至 95%。
notes.en: The baby must be born on or after 25 October 2023; for HOS/GSH the child must be 3 or under, or a family member at least 16 weeks pregnant. Under the Harmonious Families scheme you must live with, or near, and care for the elderly person. 2026 Policy Address: from the next HOS sale, White Form families with a newborn can borrow up to 95%.

source.zh: 房屋委員會：「家有初生」及「天倫樂」優先配屋計劃、居屋 2025 一般資料
source.en: Housing Authority: Families with Newborns and Harmonious Families priority schemes; HOS 2025 general information

summary.zh: 18 至 30 歲、有工作嘅香港永久性居民，可以申請租住由非政府機構營運嘅青年宿舍，儲錢上樓。
summary.en: Working Hong Kong permanent residents aged 18 to 30 can rent rooms in NGO-run youth hostels and save towards their goals.

amount.zh: 租金不超過鄰近相若單位市值六成；首次租期最少兩年，最長合共五年
amount.en: Rent no more than 60% of nearby market rent; first tenancy at least two years, up to five years in total

apply.zh: 向個別宿舍嘅營運機構申請（宿舍列表見民政及青年事務局網頁）。
apply.en: Apply to the NGO running each hostel (list on the Home and Youth Affairs Bureau website).

notes.zh: 全日制學生唔合資格；唔可以擁有香港住宅物業。入息及資產限額每年調整，一人申請約為每月 $29,200 及 $404,000，以各宿舍公布為準。
notes.en: Full-time students aren't eligible, and you can't own residential property in Hong Kong. Limits change yearly, about $29,200 a month income and $404,000 assets for one person; each hostel's announcement prevails.

source.zh: 民政及青年事務局：青年宿舍計劃；審計署報告（2026 年 3 月）
source.en: Home and Youth Affairs Bureau: Youth Hostel Scheme; Audit Commission report (March 2026)

summary.zh: 住戶（包括一人住戶）工時達標，而入息同資產低過限額，每月可以申領津貼；有 15 歲以下子女仲有兒童津貼。
summary.en: Households (including one-person households) that meet the working-hour requirement and are under the income and asset limits get a monthly allowance, plus a child allowance for children under 15.

amount.zh: 每月每戶 $575 至 $1,610（按工時同入息）；每名合資格兒童另加 $805 至 $1,610
amount.en: $575 to $1,610 a month per household (by hours and income), plus $805 to $1,610 per eligible child

apply.zh: 經職津網上平台或交表格向在職家庭津貼辦事處申請，每次申領最多六個月。
apply.en: Apply online or by form to the Working Family Allowance Office; each claim covers up to six months.

notes.zh: 非單親住戶每月合共工時要 144 小時或以上；單親住戶 36 小時或以上。
notes.en: Non-single-parent households need 144+ working hours a month in total; single-parent households 36+.

source.zh: 在職家庭及學生資助事務處：職津申請資格及津貼金額
source.en: WFSFAA: WFA eligibility and amounts

name.zh: 公共交通費用補貼計劃

summary.zh: 每月公共交通開支超過 $500，超出部分補貼三分之一，唔使申請。
summary.en: If you spend over $500 a month on public transport, a third of the excess is subsidised. No application needed.

amount.zh: 每月最多 $400；補貼 = （每月開支 − $500）÷ 3
amount.en: Up to $400 a month; subsidy = (monthly spending − $500) ÷ 3

apply.zh: 用同一張八達通或已登記嘅電子支付工具乘車，每月 16 日起喺補貼領取點或八達通 App 領取上個月嘅補貼，三個月內有效。
apply.en: Travel with the same Octopus or registered e-payment, then collect last month's subsidy from the 16th at collection points or in the Octopus app, within three months.

source.zh: 運輸署：公共交通費用補貼計劃
source.en: Transport Department: PTFSS

name.zh: 綜合社會保障援助（綜援）

summary.zh: 入息不足以應付基本生活、資產低過限額嘅住戶，可以申請綜援補足差額。
summary.en: Households whose income can't meet basic needs and whose assets are under the limits can apply for CSSA to make up the difference.

amount.zh: 按住戶嘅認可需要計算；資產上限：單身健全成人 $37,000
amount.en: Based on the household's recognised needs; asset limit for a single able-bodied adult: $37,000

apply.zh: 向社會福利署社會保障辦事處申請，或網上下載表格。
apply.en: Apply at a Social Welfare Department social security field unit, or download the form.

notes.zh: 申請人一般要成為香港居民最少一年。15 至 59 歲健全人士要積極求職，或每月工作不少於 120 小時並有不少於 $2,725 收入。
notes.en: Applicants usually need one year of Hong Kong residence. Able-bodied people aged 15 to 59 must look for work, or work 120+ hours a month earning at least $2,725.

source.zh: 社會福利署：綜援資產限額（2026 年 2 月 1 日起）
source.en: SWD: CSSA asset limits (from 1 February 2026)

name.en: Public hospital and clinic fee waiver

summary.zh: 公營醫療收費 2026 年 1 月起改革，同時大幅放寬費用減免：入息同資產喺限額之內，睇公立醫院同診所可以申請全數或部分減免。
summary.en: Alongside the public healthcare fee reform from January 2026, the fee waiver was widened: if your income and assets are within the limits, you can apply for a full or partial waiver at public hospitals and clinics.

amount.zh: 全數或部分減免收費。部分減免入息上限（每月）：1 人 $15,450、2 人 $24,200、3 人 $40,200、4 人 $55,100；入息更低一般可全數減免。資產上限跟公屋資產限額
amount.en: Full or partial waiver. Monthly income limits for a partial waiver: 1 person $15,450, 2 people $24,200, 3 people $40,200, 4 people $55,100; lower incomes usually get a full waiver. Asset limits follow the public housing asset limits

apply.zh: 向公立醫院或診所嘅醫務社會服務部，或社署綜合家庭服務中心申請；可以先用醫管局「經濟審查計算程式」自己估。
apply.en: Apply at the medical social services department of a public hospital or clinic, or an SWD integrated family service centre. You can first try the Hospital Authority's online calculator.

notes.zh: 未婚、唔係受供養嘅成年病人當一人家庭計（唔計同住父母）。家中每有一名 65 歲或以上長者，資產上限加 $168,000。綜援受助人可以直接豁免收費。減免最長有效 18 個月。
notes.en: An unmarried adult patient who is not a dependant is assessed as a one-person household (parents living with you are not counted). The asset limit rises by $168,000 for each household member aged 65+. CSSA recipients are exempt. A waiver lasts up to 18 months.

source.zh: 醫院管理局：醫療費用援助優化措施（2025 年 11 月）及經濟審查計算程式
source.en: Hospital Authority: enhanced medical fee assistance (November 2025) and financial assessment calculator

name.zh: 低收入照顧者生活津貼

summary.zh: 每月照顧輪候長期護理服務嘅長者，或者殘疾家人最少 80 小時，而住戶入息低過限額，可以申請。
summary.en: If you care for an elderly person waiting for long-term care, or a family member with a disability, for 80+ hours a month and your household income is under the limit, you can apply.

amount.zh: 每月 $3,000（照顧多於一名長者最高 $6,000）；2026 年施政報告宣布上調至每月 $3,300，以社署公布為準
amount.en: $3,000 a month (up to $6,000 for more than one elderly person). The 2026 Policy Address announced a rise to $3,300; SWD's announcement prevails

apply.zh: 向社會福利署（護老者計劃）或負責個案嘅社工查詢申請。
apply.en: Apply through the Social Welfare Department carer schemes or your case social worker.

notes.zh: 照顧者本身唔可以領取綜援、長者生活津貼或傷殘津貼；資產唔計算。
notes.en: The carer can't receive CSSA, Old Age Living Allowance or Disability Allowance; assets aren't counted.

source.zh: 社會福利署：為低收入家庭護老者提供生活津貼計劃
source.en: SWD: Living Allowance for Low-income Carers of Elderly Persons

summary.zh: 嬰兒喺香港出生，而申請時父母其中一方係香港永久性居民，可以獲發獎勵金。計劃已延續至 2029 年 10 月 24 日。
summary.en: For babies born in Hong Kong where one parent is a permanent resident when applying. The scheme now runs to 24 October 2029.

amount.zh: 每名嬰兒 $20,000；2026 年 9 月 16 日或以後喺香港出生嘅第二名或之後子女建議增至 $30,000（有待立法會通過）
amount.en: $20,000 per baby; proposed $30,000 for a second or later child born in Hong Kong on or after 16 September 2026 (subject to Legislative Council approval)

apply.zh: 出生後 42 日內辦理出生登記時一併申請；逾期亦可喺出生起計 6 個月內申請。
apply.en: Apply when registering the birth within 42 days, or within 6 months of birth.

source.zh: 政務司司長辦公室：新生嬰兒獎勵金；立法會文件（2026 年 9 月）
source.en: Chief Secretary for Administration's Office: Newborn Baby Bonus; LegCo paper (September 2026)

name.zh: 學校書簿津貼（中小學生資助）

summary.zh: 子女讀中小學，家庭入息經審查後可以獲發書簿津貼，同一份申請亦包括其他中小學生資助。
summary.en: If your children are in primary or secondary school, a means test can give you textbook assistance; the same application covers other school-level aid.

amount.zh: 2026/27 學年全額例如小學每年 $6,398；半額約為全額一半
amount.en: 2026/27 full rate e.g. $6,398 a year for primary; half rate is about half

apply.zh: 每年經學生資助處「學生資助計劃綜合申請」申請；2026/27 學年截止 2026 年 10 月 31 日，下一個學年留意學資處公布。
apply.en: Apply each year through the Student Finance Office combined application; the 2026/27 deadline was 31 October 2026, so watch for the next year's announcement.

notes.zh: 用「調整後家庭收入」計：全年入息 ÷（家庭人數 + 1）。
notes.en: Uses adjusted family income: annual income ÷ (family size + 1).

source.zh: 學生資助處：中、小學生資助計劃
source.en: Student Finance Office: primary and secondary student aid

name.zh: 幼稚園及幼兒中心學費減免
name.en: Kindergarten and Child Care Centre Fee Remission

summary.zh: 子女讀幼稚園或者幼兒中心全日制服務，家庭入息經審查後可以減免學費；幼稚園學生仲可以申請就學開支津貼。
summary.en: If your child attends kindergarten or full-day child care, a means test can reduce the fees; kindergarten pupils can also get a student grant.

amount.zh: 按「調整後家庭收入」減免全額、3/4 額或半額學費（2026/27 學年：$46,292 或以下全額、$89,515 以上唔合資格）
amount.en: Full, 3/4 or half fee remission by adjusted family income (2026/27: full rate at $46,292 or below, not eligible above $89,515)

apply.zh: 經學生資助處「學生資助計劃綜合申請」申請（同書簿津貼同一份表），每個學年都要申請；2026/27 學年建議 5 月 31 日前交。
apply.en: Apply each school year through the Student Finance Office combined application (the same form as textbook assistance); for 2026/27 it was best to apply by 31 May.

notes.zh: 幼稚園要係參加「幼稚園教育計劃」嘅本地課程幼稚園；幼兒中心要係社署轄下全日制服務，仲要通過「社會需要」審查，半日制唔資助。「調整後家庭收入」= 全年入息 ÷（家庭人數 + 1）。
notes.en: The kindergarten must offer a local curriculum under the Kindergarten Education Scheme; child care must be full-day at an SWD centre and also pass a social needs test (half-day isn't covered). Adjusted family income = annual income ÷ (family size + 1).

source.zh: 學生資助處：幼稚園及幼兒中心學費減免計劃
source.en: Student Finance Office: Kindergarten and Child Care Centre Fee Remission Scheme

summary.zh: 60 歲或以上香港居民乘搭指定交通工具，成人車費 $10 或以下付 $2，超過 $10 付兩折。
summary.en: Residents aged 60+ pay $2 for adult fares of $10 or less, or 20% of fares over $10, on designated transport.

amount.zh: 成人車費 $10 或以下：$2；超過 $10：成人車費兩折（2026 年 4 月 3 日起）
amount.en: Adult fare $10 or less: $2; over $10: 20% of the adult fare (from 3 April 2026)

apply.zh: 用「樂悠咭」或長者八達通乘車，唔使另外申請。
apply.en: Use a JoyYou Card or Elder Octopus; no separate application.

source.zh: 運輸署：政府長者及合資格殘疾人士公共交通票價優惠計劃
source.en: Transport Department: Government Public Transport Fare Concession Scheme

summary.zh: 65 歲或以上香港長者每年獲發醫療券，可以喺私家醫生、牙醫、中醫等使用。
summary.en: Elderly residents aged 65+ get yearly vouchers to use with private doctors, dentists, Chinese medicine practitioners and more.

amount.en: $2,000 a year, up to $8,000 accumulated

apply.zh: 毋須申請，年滿 65 歲自動合資格；到登記咗嘅醫療服務提供者出示身份證使用。
apply.en: No application: eligible automatically at 65; show the ID card at an enrolled provider.

source.zh: 醫務衞生局：長者醫療券計劃
source.en: Health Bureau: Elderly Health Care Voucher Scheme

summary.zh: 70 歲或以上、住港滿 7 年嘅長者每月可以領取，唔使經濟審查。
summary.en: Residents aged 70+ with 7 years' residence get a monthly allowance with no means test.

amount.en: $1,675 a month (from 1 February 2026)

apply.zh: 年滿 70 歲前一個月起經網上、郵寄或社會保障辦事處申請。
apply.en: Apply from one month before turning 70, online, by post or at a social security office.

notes.zh: 同一時間只可以領高齡津貼、長者生活津貼、傷殘津貼或綜援其中一項。
notes.en: Only one of OAA, Old Age Living Allowance, Disability Allowance or CSSA can be received at a time.

source.zh: 社會福利署：公共福利金計劃各類津貼金額
source.en: SWD: Social Security Allowance rates

summary.zh: 65 歲或以上、入息同資產低過限額嘅長者，每月可以領取。
summary.en: Residents aged 65+ under the income and asset limits get a monthly allowance.

amount.en: $4,345 a month. Limits: single $10,900 income and $415,000 assets; couple $16,680 and $630,000

apply.zh: 經網上、郵寄或社會保障辦事處申請。
apply.en: Apply online, by post or at a social security office.

notes.zh: 長者生活津貼同高齡津貼唔可以同時領取。
notes.en: OALA and OAA can't be received at the same time.

source.zh: 社會福利署：長者生活津貼入息及資產限額
source.en: SWD: OALA income and asset limits

summary.zh: 65 歲或以上香港居民可以免費申請長者咭，喺政府部門、公共機構同參與商戶享有折扣、優惠同優先服務。
summary.en: Residents aged 65+ can get a free Senior Citizen Card for discounts, concessions and priority service at government departments, public bodies and participating shops.

amount.zh: 免費申請（補領 $25）；亦有「智方便」電子長者咭
amount.en: Free (replacement $25); an e-card on iAM Smart is also available

apply.zh: 網上、郵寄或親身向社會福利署長者咭辦事處申請；65 歲生日前 60 日內可以預先遞交。
apply.en: Apply online, by post or in person to the SWD Senior Citizen Card Office; you can apply up to 60 days before turning 65.

source.zh: 社會福利署：長者咭計劃
source.en: SWD: Senior Citizen Card Scheme

summary.zh: 50 至 75 歲、冇大腸癌徵狀嘅香港居民，可以喺參與計劃嘅私家基層醫療醫生做政府資助篩查；大便隱血測試呈陽性就轉介做資助大腸鏡。
summary.en: Residents aged 50 to 75 without symptoms can get government-subsidised screening from participating private primary care doctors; a positive stool test leads to a subsidised colonoscopy.

amount.zh: 登記同大便隱血測試化驗由政府全數資助；醫生診症有資助，可能要付少量額外費用（視乎醫生）
amount.en: Enrolment and the stool test are fully subsidised; doctor consultations are subsidised but may carry a small co-payment depending on the doctor

apply.zh: 先登記「醫健通」，再搵參與計劃嘅基層醫療醫生登記參加。
apply.en: Register with eHealth first, then enrol with a participating primary care doctor.

notes.zh: 有大腸癌徵狀、高風險因素，或者指定期限內做過篩查或檢查嘅人士唔適用。
notes.en: Not for people with symptoms, high-risk factors, or recent screening or examination within the set period.

source.zh: 衞生署：大腸癌篩查計劃
source.en: Department of Health: Colorectal Cancer Screening Programme
